subject.title: Telegram should default to allowlist mode with owner ID

question: Should fresh Telegram onboarding replace initial DM pairing with token-verified owner capture, or retain pairing and harden only the post-approval state?
rationale: Both approaches change the first-owner authorization boundary, and the repository does not currently define whether compatibility, zero-config pairing, or fail-closed owner enrollment should take precedence.

options.title: Verified owner capture
options.body: For fresh interactive setup, require an exact random challenge token, capture that sender's numeric ID, and persist an owner-only allowlist while leaving existing configs unchanged.

options.title: Post-pairing auto-lock
options.body: Keep first-run pairing, then convert an omitted policy to a durable owner allowlist after the first explicitly approved owner, aligning with the broader post-bootstrap proposal.

options.title: Keep pairing default
options.body: Retain current behavior and improve setup warnings, owner-ID assistance, and documentation without changing admission defaults.

recommendation.title: Verified owner capture
recommendation.body: For fresh interactive setup, require an exact random challenge token, capture that sender's numeric ID, and persist an owner-only allowlist while leaving existing configs unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across Telegram runtime, onboarding, docs, and the prior security/product review of this exact request.
